title: AnimationPlaybackTrack's sub AnimationPlayer discrete key is not processed in the frame which just stopping parent AnimationPlayer
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.5.1-stable

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot Mono 4.5.1 stable - Compatibility

### Issue description

Normally, function calls in Call Method tracks work just fine. However, if you start an animation in one AnimationPlayer from another AnimationPlayer via an Animation Playback track, the function will not be called. In the attached project, you can see that `SomeOtherFunc` gets called just fine. This function is called from the `scroll` animation in `AnimationPlayer`. `SomeFunc` is _not_ called, though. This function is called from the `fade_in` animation in `AnimationPlayer2`. `fade_in` is started by an Animation Playback track in the `scroll` animation of `AnimationPlayer`.

### Steps to reproduce

* Create a new node.
* Attach a script to this new node and add a function that does something basic, like `print()`.
* Add two AnimationPlayer nodes to this new node.
* Create a new animation in each AnimationPlayer.
* Create a new track in one AnimationPlayer that calls the animation in the other AnimationPlayer.
* In the other AnimationPlayer, add a new track to call the function you created in the parent node.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24548586/new-game-project.zip)
